description: Real internal DITA T819 follow-up transcript after a client call, benchmarked against the human internal minutes PDF for objective, working-session plan, regulatory scope questions and concrete follow-up actions.

mustContain: PPE and sunglasses requirements should be covered in the procedures
Working sessions should be scheduled for Wednesday, Thursday and Friday
Set up working sessions with the client
Confirm the PPE and sunglasses procedure scope with the client
Follow up internally on declaration of conformity language requirements
Schedule a weekly client check-in call

mustNotContain: their risk. No, it's not ours
Okay, I can take that as an action

abstention.reason: Internal follow-up should capture the human-minutes coverage: objective/follow-up from the client call, working sessions, weekly client connect, questions/clarifications, site visit follow-up, PPE/sunglasses scope, MDR/PPE declaration context, and unresolved DoC language requirements without leaking raw chatter.
